_about: Shown once on each phone after it installs a new Android update (not on a first install). Replace the list with what this update changes, in plain words, each time an Android update is approved and built.
items: Fixed: reading manifest photos (and Read the printed LPN) works again in the Android app. Before, the photo reader couldn’t start inside the app and gave up after 90 seconds.

The app now opens on a start menu: choose Log pallets or Manifest check. Each has its own page, with its name and ‹ Menu in a bar that stays at the top (Back goes to the menu too). The menu also shows a delivery in progress (with Carry on scanning) and your last few saved deliveries, with buttons for Saved deliveries and Exported files.

A tidier app bar: Guide, Changelog, Settings, Exported files and a new About screen (with your data and the app’s open-source licences) are in the ⋮ menu at the top. Reading photos shows a progress bar with Cancel, and if you switch away while photos are read, a notification says when they’re done.

Zebra and Honeywell handheld scanners: scans now come straight into the app instead of being typed, so a scan can’t land in the wrong box, with the same buzz and sound as a camera scan and a green (or orange, for a check) flash round the screen. On the log it’s logged as the next pallet; on the Manifest check it’s added to the manifest numbers. Untick it in Settings › Android app if your scanner should type like a keyboard.
Choose a folder for exports in Settings › Android app (for example a OneDrive or Google Drive folder on the phone): every export is then saved there too, as well as in Documents › LPN Pallet Log.

Smaller things: Settings › Android app is grouped into Scanning, Photos, Display and Exports; the Manifest date shows as day/month/year like the delivery date; the “New here?” card is gone; and a tidier footer.

Settings › Android app › Photos can switch manifest photos to the phone’s own text reader. It can be faster, but the app’s own reader (still the default) is more accurate; a ✓ Saved tick after each change; Next on the keyboard moves through the Delivery boxes; and if something ever goes wrong, a plain message says your log is safe, with Try again.
Scan sounds and the spoken count follow the phone: on silent, vibrate or Do Not Disturb you only get the buzz. Settings › Android app can turn this off.
